title: Section Conjecture for Hyperbolic Curves
exact_target: Let $X/k$ be a smooth geometrically connected hyperbolic curve over a number field or a finite extension of $\mathbb Q_p$. Does the map sending a rational point to its decomposition-group section biject $X(k)$ with conjugacy classes of continuous sections of $\pi_1(X/k)\to\operatorname{Gal}(\overline k/k)$?
